title: Career Roadmap · Digital Marketing Executive
summary: A Digital Marketing Executive plans, executes, monitors, and improves online marketing campaigns to increase brand awareness, website traffic, customer engagement, leads, and sales. The role combines creativity, communication, data analysis, and digital technology.

blocks.text: A Digital Marketing Executive plans, executes, monitors, and improves online marketing campaigns to increase brand awareness, website traffic, customer engagement, leads, and sales. The role combines creativity, communication, data analysis, and digital technology.

Digital Marketing Executives work with websites, search engines, social media platforms, email campaigns, paid advertisements, and e-commerce marketplaces. They collaborate with designers, content writers, sales teams, and business owners to achieve measurable marketing goals.
Key responsibilities

items.text: Plan and publish content across digital channels.
Conduct keyword research and implement search engine optimization (SEO).
Manage social media calendars and audience engagement.
Assist with paid advertising campaigns on search and social platforms.
Create email campaigns, newsletters, and customer follow-up sequences.
Monitor website traffic, conversions, leads, and campaign costs.
Prepare reports and recommend performance improvements.
Support product listings, promotions, and conversion optimization for e-commerce stores.
Coordinate with designers and content creators on campaign assets.
Maintain brand consistency and follow advertising, privacy, and platform policies.

blocks.text: The following roadmap assumes a three-year B.Voc programme. Adapt the sequence to the institution's actual semesters and curriculum.
Year 1
Foundation
Learn marketing fundamentals and digital platforms

items.text: Understand marketing principles, customer behavior, segmentation, and positioning.
Learn branding, marketing funnels, customer journeys, and value propositions.
Study SEO fundamentals, search intent, keyword research, and on-page optimization.
Learn social media strategy and content calendar planning.
Practise copywriting for advertisements, websites, and social posts.
Understand website basics, landing pages, HTML/CSS concepts, and content management systems.
Learn spreadsheet fundamentals using Excel or Google Sheets.
Explore basic design tools for social posts and marketing materials.

blocks.label: Practical milestone
blocks.text: Build a sample brand profile, a one-month content calendar, and a basic SEO-optimized landing page.
Year 2
Execution
Develop campaign management and analytics skills

items.text: Learn the fundamentals of paid search and paid social campaigns.
Practise audience research, campaign objectives, budgeting, and creative testing.
Learn Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
Study email marketing, segmentation, automated workflows, and lead nurturing.
Understand conversion rate optimization and landing-page design.
Explore e-commerce platforms, product listings, online merchandising, and checkout journeys.
Learn UTM tagging, attribution fundamentals, and marketing KPI reporting.
Complete a practical project using a real or simulated business brief.

blocks.label: Practical milestone
blocks.text: Prepare and evaluate a digital campaign plan with a defined audience, budget, KPIs, and reporting dashboard.
Year 3
Job readiness
Build specialization and workplace readiness

items.text: Complete an internship with a digital agency, startup, or e-commerce company.
Manage a small campaign or content project with measurable objectives.
Practise SEO audits, competitor analysis, and content performance reviews.
Develop paid campaign reporting and budget tracking skills.
Learn CRM fundamentals and lead-management workflows.
Use AI tools to assist research, ideation, drafting, and reporting while checking accuracy and originality.
Prepare a portfolio with campaign briefs, content samples, SEO audits, and analytics reports.
Practise interview questions, campaign case studies, and marketing metrics.

blocks.label: Practical milestone
blocks.text: Present a portfolio demonstrating strategy, execution, performance measurement, and evidence-based optimization.

blocks.text: Digital marketing campaign for a small business or e-commerce store.

blocks.text: The student should become competent in the core channels before trying to master every marketing platform.
By the end of the B.Voc programme, a job-ready student should aim to have:

items.text: A portfolio containing at least three substantial marketing projects.
Practical understanding of SEO, social media, content, and paid advertising fundamentals.
Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 and Search Console.
The ability to prepare a clear marketing dashboard using spreadsheets.
Experience with a simulated or real campaign and transparent reporting of results.
Knowledge of e-commerce customer journeys and product-page optimization.
At least one relevant internship or practical industry assignment.
Two or three relevant certifications selected for the intended specialization.
Strong writing, presentation, research, and teamwork skills.
Awareness of privacy, copyright, advertising disclosures, and platform policies.

blocks.label: Recommended first career target
blocks.text: Digital Marketing Executive.

blocks.label: Best initial strategy
blocks.text: Build broad fundamentals across SEO, content, social media, and analytics, then specialize in either performance marketing, SEO, or e-commerce growth.

blocks.label: Most valuable differentiator
blocks.text: The ability to explain what a campaign achieved, why it performed that way, and what should be improved next.

blocks.label: Long-term opportunity
blocks.text: Progress into digital marketing management, growth marketing, marketing analytics, consulting, or an independent digital marketing agency.
